name: isSSOEnforcedForAllUsers
definition: True when every user login the tool lists signs in through single sign-on (the tool marks each user as an SSO user). False when any listed user does not. A login the tool does not list (for example the account owner) is not judged.
population: the user logins one tool account lists; denominator = every user the read lists (paged to the end)
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete, paged read of every listed user showing each one is an SSO user; an error, 401/403, 5xx, timeout, unparsable body, missing field, empty user list or a read cut off by the page cap is Not evaluated.
citations: SendGrid API reference, Teammates (twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/teammates): GET /v3/teammates returns is_sso per teammate; scope teammates.read

changeLog.change: Registered so the SendGrid transformation can emit it. Meaning written from the public SendGrid API reference and one read of a real account (read-only); no replay-backed validation yet, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Messaging Security is allowed too because the SendGrid integration is catalogued under communication (Messaging Security). Evidence names users by the part before any @, never an email address. SendGrid's parent account owner login is outside its teammates list. SSO enforcement in the sense of 'password sign-in switched off' is not exposed by SendGrid; this key is the per-user fact.
